points.description: States that the number of comparisons needed is equal to (at most) the height of the tree, using the term 'height' (or depth of the deepest path/levels from root to leaf).
points.partial_credit: Half (1.5) if it gives the number of levels/depth along a root-to-node path but does not use 'height' or say it is bounded by the height.

points.description: States the equivalent logarithmic form: the number of comparisons is about log (base 2) of the number of elements n, i.e. O(log n), for a balanced tree.
points.partial_credit: Half (1) if it says 'logarithmic' or O(log n) without relating it to the number of elements n or without stating it as the tree's height.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the precise term 'height' of the tree and the logarithm of the number of elements (log n). Part marks only when clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely. Answers like 'a few comparisons', 'n comparisons', or linear/total number of nodes earn nothing for the points they contradict; a wrong statement on a point voids that point.
